repairs.action: The Model and valuation 'Judgment (net cash)' paragraph quotes the omitted amounts from filing text: Q-13 (MD&A: $56.6bn cash, cash equivalents and marketable debt securities; $42.8bn marketable equity securities), Q-11/Q-12 (balance-sheet lines 34,143 and 42,783 in millions) and Q-17 (the $36.9bn lock-up). It says code's net cash is understated because no snapshot XBRL concept carries these lines, and that the published target price does not include them. It also states that in the analyst's offline check (gen-valuation: target about $183-185, upside -12.7% to -11.8%) adding the debt securities at full value plus the equity securities, with the haircut or at full value, raises the target only slightly, keeps upside below minus ten percent and the rating Underperform, with the margin to the band edge about two percentage points at most (words only). The published figure is still wrong in code: valuation.json net_cash stays -10.923B. A controller- or code-level mechanism for filing-text balance-sheet items, or a controller-recorded acceptance decision, is still needed.
Omitted amounts stated via [[Q-13]], [[Q-11]] and [[Q-12]]. The robustness claim now covers the equity securities as well (with the haircut or at full value), and the thin-margin caveat is explicit.
The note now says net cash 'deducts total debt (short-term plus long-term debt) from mapped cash and cash equivalents only'.

New 'Judgment (discount rate)' paragraph: at a WACC roughly half a percentage point lower than ours (about a third to a half of a percentage point, depending on net cash treatment), upside would cross into the Neutral band. It notes that the unrounded CAPM rate is used. The Risks section and the Key points judgment bullet repeat the point. Words only.

The valuation section states that peer TTM windows end May-June 2026 (AVGO and MRVL in May, AMD in June), against July 2026 for NVDA. The peers.json calendar label is a code issue that gen-valuation has flagged to the controller.

Disclosures now say the filing accession, exact cutoff time and price date are printed in the Data and Sources block of the published PDF, and that this note is distributed only through that publication. values.json has no accession/cutoff_utc/price_date keys and the gate blocks literal digits, so full closure needs those keys from code, or a controller confirmation that distribution goes only through publish.py.
EX-99.1 and EX-99.2 are now attributed to 'the company's same-day Form 8-K, which was accepted before the cutoff', not to the 10-Q.
The fourth Key points bullet is split into '**Valuation (code output):**' (price, target, upside, band) and '**Judgment:**' (interpretation only).

notes: Started from round-001 note.md. Re-ran eu.py compute after writing: gate_findings empty, target_price 182, rating Underperform (it matches gen-valuation's offline result at WACC 10.7%). Only {{key}} placeholders from values.json and [[Q-1]]..[[Q-13]], [[Q-17]] are used. Q-14, Q-15, Q-16 and Q-18 are not cited. Remaining digits are only 2026, 10-Q, 8-K and EX-99.x labels.
